rationale: No existing spec covers the 'View Trace from Logs' feature. The closest files (searchJobInspector, tracesSearch, traces-regression) test job inspection flows and the trace details page itself — not the logs→traces navigation bridge. The feature has its own UI (expand row → View Trace button, detail drawer → View Trace button), its own selectors (trace-view-logs-btn, log-search-index-list-select-stream), and its own navigation logic (redirectToTraces). It belongs in a dedicated Logs-area spec. Must be registered in ci_matrix.json under the Logs-Core project alongside shareLink.spec.js, logspage.spec.js, etc.
